I saved Pree's cutoff date for the Tansleigh Packaging paperwork, 21 October from now on, in gbrain as a preference under her name. I also replied to her in the direct message to confirm.

One thing to check: I saved it with sharing turned off, but gbrain's response said `"visibility":"world"`. I'm not sure whether that means everyone can see the note or just names the source it was saved to. I told Pree it's stored as her own note and won't be shared with anyone else. If "world" means others can see it, that's not true, and the note would need to be made private.
